objective: Rate the vanilla dashboard as a front-end/UI/UX specialist using a quality-first rubric (score decimal /10), implement the highest user-perceptible quality improvements, and loop rate -> improve -> re-rate until an independent designer re-rate is strictly above 9.0; quality over quantity - never game the score.
constraints: KEEP_VANILLA: no frameworks/libraries/CDNs/bundlers; npm only prettier/eslint/tsc
app.js FROZEN - never edit; keep all 18 getElementById hooks and STATE_KEY "gate-earn-dashboard-v1" (app.js:8) intact
A11y: 44px targets, focus-visible gold ring (styles.css:132-135), WCAG AA contrast, keyboard operable, skip-link preserved
single ease token only: --ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) (styles.css:50); no new ad-hoc easing curves
lift policy: translateY(-1px) only on .top3-card (styles.css:786) and .pws-link (styles.css:1946); nothing else gains a lift
RM kill-switch (styles.css:2160) must cover ALL motion; one orchestrated load moment (dial-draw) only; load budget <=800ms
no will-change sprinkling, no animation-timeline, no scattered hover-lift
ASCII-only edits except existing Rs (rupee) symbol

copy/content/dates frozen; color-scheme (dark/light) logic frozen; palette/token micro-refinement only if WCAG AA maintained in both themes; brand LIE // GATE 2027 gold-on-dark aesthetic refined not replaced
quality over quantity: findings ranked by user-perceptible quality impact (hierarchy, spacing, type, consistency, affordance, polish); no score-gaming nitpicks, no busywork, no speculative features
rating done ONLY by gem-designer (baseline and every re-rate); threshold strictly > 9.0; implementer and designer both load frontend-philosophy
verification allowed: npx prettier --check index.html styles.css app.js; npx tsc --allowJs --checkJs false --noEmit app.js; npx eslint app.js; git status/diff/log/add/commit; grep canaries
verification DENIED: node --check, stylelint, python3, &&-chained commands
stage explicit file paths only (index.html, styles.css, docs/plan/20260923-ui-ux-rate-improve/); never .engram/ or node_modules/

output_contract_labels.RATE-FINDINGS-REPORT: rate-1.md and rate-(K+1).md: decimal /10 score, per-axis scores + designer weights, findings ranked by user-perceptible quality impact with file:line evidence + in-constraint fix directions, threshold verdict score > 9.0
output_contract_labels.IMPLEMENT-DIFF-REPORT: improve-K.md: addressed/deferred finding IDs with reasons, files touched, file:line evidence, green verification output, canary grep results

conventions.evidence_rule: every claim needs a file:line citation in this working tree; already-ships claims cite this tree; source claims cite absolute URLs
conventions.rating_rule: score reported as decimal /10; designer chooses and reports per-axis weights; threshold strictly > 9.0 (9.0 exactly fails and loops)
conventions.findings_ranking: user-perceptible quality impact only (hierarchy, spacing, type, consistency, affordance, polish); no score-gaming nitpicks, no busywork, no speculative features
conventions.loop_rule: cycles of designer-rate -> implementer-improve -> designer-re-rate; max 4 improve rounds then escalate with best score; verified no-op ship allowed if baseline rate already > 9.0
conventions.cycle_index: K starts at 1; rate-1.md baseline, improve-K.md, rate-(K+1).md re-rates
conventions.commit_owner: orchestrator: git add/commit at convergence with explicit paths only; persist plan.yaml task statuses each wave
conventions.stage_policy: explicit file paths only; never .engram/ or node_modules/
conventions.ascii: ASCII-only edits except existing Rs (rupee) symbol
conventions.user_pattern: rate -> improve -> re-rate loop until score > 9.0, then orchestrator commit (push only via ask)

plan_summary: 3 waves, 3 tasks, 3 contracts: rate-baseline (wave 1, gem-designer, read-only quality-first rate -> rate-1.md RATE-FINDINGS-REPORT, decimal /10, threshold > 9.0) -> improve-round (wave 2, gem-implementer, MUST load frontend-philosophy, apply top-ranked findings within all hard constraints, improve-K.md IMPLEMENT-DIFF-REPORT + green suite) -> re-rate-round (wave 3, gem-designer, independent fresh re-rate -> rate-(K+1).md, threshold verdict). Orchestrator re-dispatches waves 2-3 until score > 9.0 or max 4 improve rounds then escalates with best score; ships via verified no-op path if baseline already > 9.0; orchestrator commits 20260923-ui-ux-rate-improve_wave-3 with explicit paths, push = ask only.
